chapterInfo.content:
20
Pasur yɛ Yeremia aninyanneɛ
1Na Imer ba Pasur, ɔsɔfoɔ a ɔyɛ AWURADE fie so titire no tee sɛ Yeremia reka adiyisɛm yi no, 2Pasur boroo Odiyifoɔ Yeremia, na ɔde no bɔɔ duam, Benyamin ponkɛseɛ a ɛwɔ soro, AWURADE fie mu no mu. 3Na adeɛ kyeeɛ no, Pasur yii Yeremia firii dua no mu. Na Yeremia ka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Ɛnyɛ Pasur#20.3 Asekyerɛ ne: Ahosɛpɛ. na AWURADE ato wo din, na mmom Magormisabib.#20.3 Asekyerɛ ne: Ehu wɔ afa nyinaa. 4Na sɛ AWURADE seɛ nie: Hwɛ, mereyɛ wo ehuyideɛ ama wo ho ne w’adɔfo nyinaa anim, na wɔatotɔ wɔn atamfoɔ afena ano, na w’ani bɛhunu, na mede Yuda nyinaa bɛhyɛ Babel hene nsa, na watu wɔn akɔ Babel, na ɔde afena akunkum wɔn. 5#Yes 36.6 Na mɛyi kuro yi adedodoɔ ne emu mfasodeɛ aboɔdenneɛ nyinaa mama, na mede Yuda ahemfo akoradeɛ nyinaa mahyɛ wɔn atamfoɔ nsa, na wɔafomfom afa akɔ Babel. 6Na wo, Pasur, ne wo fiefoɔ nyinaa, mobɛkɔ nnommumfa mu, na wobɛkɔ Babel akɔwu wɔ hɔ, na wɔasie wo wɔ hɔ, wo ne w’adɔfoɔ a wohyɛɛ wɔn nkɔntorɔ no nyinaa.
Odiyifoɔ no abooboo denden
7 # Yer 1.7 Woagyegye me, AWURADE,
na mapene nnyegyeɛ no so.
Woatintim me so,
na woatumi.
Madane aseredeɛ daa nyinaa;
wɔn nyinaa di me ho fɛw.
8 # Yes 49.4 Na daa merekasa a, ɛma meteam,
atiritirasɛm ne ɔsɛeɛ na ɛma mesu mefrɛ,
na AWURADE asɛm adane me
ahohora ne nsopa daa nyinaa.
9Na sɛ mese: Merenkae no
na meremmɔ ne din menkasa bio, a,
na ɛyɛ m’akoma mu sɛ ogya a ɛredɛre
a wɔato mu me nnompe mu;
mesɔ mu a mebrɛ ho,
na mentumi.
10 # Dwom 31.3 Na mate nnipa pii nsekudie,
ehu wɔ afa nyinaa,
wɔse: Monkɔka, na yɛbɛkɔ akɔka atia no.
Nnipa a me ne wɔn nni asɛm biara
a wɔtete me ho nyinaa ka sɛ:
Ebia ɔbɛma wɔagyegye no,
na yɛatumi no,
na yɛatɔ yɛn were wɔ ne so.
11 # Yer 1.8, 19; 15.20 Na AWURADE gyina m’akyiri sɛ dɔmmarima a ne ho yɛ hu,
ɛno nti m’atifoɔ bɛsuntisunti,
na wɔrentumi.
Wɔn ani bɛwuwu sɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛrensi wɔn yie,
ɛyɛ daa nsopa
a werɛ remfire.
12 # Yer 11.20 Na asafo AWURADE a wosɔ ɔteneneeni hwɛ,
hwɛ adwene ne akoma mu.
Wɔn so na mɛhunu wo aweretɔ,
na wo na mede m’asɛm madane woɔ.
13Monto dwom mma AWURADE,
monyi AWURADE ayɛ!
Na wayi ohiani kra
afiri nnipa bɔne nsam.
14 # Yer 15.10; Hiob 3.1-10; 10.18 Nnome nka da
a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no!
Ɛda a me na woo me no,
mma wɔnnhyira no.
15Nnome nka onipa
a ɔde asɛmpa no brɛɛ m’agya sɛ:
Wɔawo ɔbabarima ama wo!
na ɔde maa n’ani gyee pii no.
16 # Gye 19.24-25 Ma onii no nyɛ sɛ nkuro
a AWURADE abutubutuo wɔ anibereɛ so no;
ma no nte esu anɔpa
ne gyegyeegye awia ketee.
17Sɛ wankum me wɔ ɔyafunu mu,
na me na annane me damena
na manka ne yafunum daa nti.
18Adɛn nti mpo na mefirii yafunum firii adie,
sɛ merebɛhunu ɔbrɛ ne ahometeɛ,
na me nna ahi aniwuo mu!

Woagyegye me, AWURADE,
na mapene nnyegyeɛ no so.

na woatumi.

wɔn nyinaa di me ho fɛw.

Na AWURADE gyina m’akyiri sɛ dɔmmarima a ne ho yɛ hu,

Wɔn ani bɛwuwu sɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ ɛrensi wɔn yie,
ɛyɛ daa nsopa
a werɛ remfire.

Wɔn so na mɛhunu wo aweretɔ,

Monto dwom mma AWURADE,
monyi AWURADE ayɛ!
Na wayi ohiani kra
afiri nnipa bɔne nsam.
Nnome nka da
a wɔwoo me wɔ mu no!
Ɛda a me na woo me no,
mma wɔnnhyira no.
Nnome nka onipa
a ɔde asɛmpa no brɛɛ m’agya sɛ:

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
